metadata.description: Agent skills for adopting the pixiv charcoal design system (@charcoal-ui)

plugins.name: charcoal
plugins.description: Set up @charcoal-ui in an app, choose the right token for a color, text style, spacing, radius or border, and turn a Figma link into files a teammate can build from without any Figma access of their own. Covers Design Token 2.0 opt-in, theme switching, and the gotchas that silently produce an unstyled or Token 1.0 app.
